claims: Compact/Assembly/Final.lean: theorem N12Compact.Final.optimality : S12.packingConstant12 = 4, with no hypothesis, := SourceAssembly.optimality SourceAssembly.pending_closed. source/S12/PackingConstant.lean defines feasibleSides := {L | 0 < L and Nonempty (UnitPacking L)} and packingConstant12 := sInf feasibleSides, and proves four_feasible from gridPacking, the 4 x 3 grid; source/S12/Normalization.lean defines UnitPacking L as twelve OpenSquare with side 1, every interior point in [0, L]^2 and pairwise disjoint interiors; source/S12/Diagonal.lean defines OpenSquare (c, s with c^2 + s^2 = 1, loU, loV, side > 0) and Inside as the open band loU < c x + s y < loU + side, loV < -s x + c y < loV + side.

README.md: the squares may have arbitrary orientations and translations, interiors disjoint and boundary contact allowed; the theorem supplies the global lower bound and a 4-by-3 grid attaining side 4. Credits: Jatloe provided the full mathematical proof and partial Lean formalization; Ben Gurevitch aided in formalization; CTJLewis refactored and compiled the formalization.
